title: Apply for a Rentstart Bond Loan
summary: You can apply for a Rentstart Bond Loan, an interest-free loan up to 100% of your rental bond, if you are having financial difficulty entering the private rental market.
intro:
If you are finding it financially difficult to get into the private rental market you may be eligible to apply for a Rentstart Bond Loan. The interest-free loan can be up to 100% of your rental bond.

If no claim is made by the landlord or real estate agent at the end of the tenancy the money you have repaid to Homes NSW is returned to you.

You can apply for a Rentstart Bond Loan online or by using a PDF form.

### Rent Choice

If you have been approved for Rent Choice you:
who_can_apply: Meet the household income and assets eligibility limits.
Have less than $5,000 in cash assets.
Not own or part-own property (waivers may apply).
Be approved for the rental property.
Be an Australian citizen or permanent resident in NSW.
what_you_need: Two current proof of identity documents (e.g., bank statement(s) for the previous 4 weeks, pay slips, proof of assets, Australian citizenship or permanent residency documents).
An email address for the real estate agent or landlord for the property.

If applying with a PDF form, you will need to complete 'Part A – Application for Rentstart Bond Loan' and ask the real estate agent or property owner (landlord) to complete 'Part C – Property Information'.

Depending on your situation, you may also need to complete 'Part E – Rentstart Bond Loan Agreement', 'Part B – Additional Persons', 'Part D – Income from Employment', or 'Authority for Bond Loan Deduction'.
If changing your name, you may need a Deed Poll document, change of name certificate, or marriage certificate.

faqs.q: What happens to the loan money if the tenancy ends?
faqs.a: If no claim is made by the landlord or real estate agent at the end of the tenancy, the money you have repaid to Homes NSW is returned to you.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for the Rentstart Bond Loan?
faqs.a: Applicants must be aged 18 or over, be eligible for social housing, meet household income and assets eligibility limits, have less than $5,000 in cash assets, not own or part-own property, be approved for the rental property, and be an Australian citizen or permanent resident in NSW.

faqs.q: How does the Rentstart Bond Loan work?
faqs.a: The loan is based on how much of your income is spent on rent, covers a 12 or 18-month period, and requires fortnightly payments to Homes NSW.
